newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS share index closes at record 362.52.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS share index closes at record 362.52.

text.p: The Russian Trading System index of 22 shares closed on Friday at a record 362.52 on total market volume of $68.85 million, the NAUFOR brokers association said.
The index closed on Thursday at 357.00 on $51.7 million in volume.
The previous record was on Monday, when the index rose to 360.72.
It was unclear whether the volume also hit a record as NAUFOR has changed the methodology of calculating the volume and now counts only confirmed deals.
Higher volume figures were recorded earlier in the year, but these were calculated under the old system.
